population.predicate: conflicted merge row with both_sides_touched_tests=true in corpus/conflicts/<slug>.jsonl

patch_rule.test_paths: exact diffs.parent{i}.test_files paths from the canonical JSONL row
patch_rule.source_paths: all other changed paths in that base-to-parent diff
patch_rule.application: each arm starts from a fresh exported B tree; source and test patches are never layered on an earlier outcome arm

focal_selection_rule.direct_targets: Each changed conventional pytest module whose basename matches test*.py is a whole-module collector target. A nonconventional changed artifact is a direct target only if pytest itself collects one or more items when it is passed explicitly. conftest.py, package initializers, typing fixtures, and golden/support outputs that yield no pytest items are recorded as unmapped support paths, not silently called focal tests.
focal_selection_rule.overlay_collection: Apply the complete side-i test patch to B and collect every direct target with plugin autoload disabled. Missing conventional modules, collection errors, or zero collected items reject the side.
focal_selection_rule.node_ids: The sorted unique direct collector targets (normally changed test-module paths) are the frozen focal node ids. Collected leaf item ids are evidence recorded separately for each state, not a replacement target set.
focal_selection_rule.base_collection: Every frozen collector target must exist and collect at least one item at untouched B. A missing target, collection error, or zero-item result rejects the side. Added leaf tests inside an existing module remain included in red/green runs because the module target is unchanged.
focal_selection_rule.no_outcome_adaptation: No direct target is removed because of a collection or test outcome. Every non-direct test-patch path and its mapping status remains recorded.

independent_checks.base: Run the exact focal collector targets five times on five fresh untouched B exports. All five runs must be pytest-green (exit zero, no failure/error), and normalized JUnit case/outcome signatures must be identical. Stable unrelated skips/xfails are allowed as in fixture/click/GATE.md and are counted.
independent_checks.red: On a fresh B export apply only side i's test patch and run the exact focal collector targets. Outcome-blind collection freezes this overlay's exact leaf item ids. A qualifying red exits 1 and has at least one test-level failure or error, with no collection/import/internal/usage error.
independent_checks.green: On a fresh B export apply both side i patches and run the exact focal collector targets. It must collect exactly the frozen overlay leaf ids, exit zero, and every leaf that failed/errored in red must be present with outcome passed (not skipped/xfail). Stable unrelated skips are counted but do not invalidate green.
independent_checks.site: Both sides must independently pass base determinism, red, and green. Two non-red test-only greens are classified as a non-probe rejection.

joint_check.construction: Intersect the canonical merge-tree conflicted paths with the two source-path sets. A nonempty intersection is a textual source conflict and is not constructible. Otherwise construct the exact source-only joint patch as B-to-canonical-result-tree restricted to the union of source paths; sequential unified-patch context failure is not used to infer conflict.
joint_check.evaluation: When the two source patches combine, evaluate each side on a fresh copy containing both source patches plus that side's own test patch, using that side's frozen focal node ids.
joint_check.contradiction: Call a site mutually unsatisfiable only when at least one joint focal set is stably non-green on an immediate identical rerun while the other is green or stably non-green. A disagreeing rerun is unverified, not contradictory.

apparatus_path_policy.execution_temp: Every environment probe and pytest subprocess receives a distinct initially empty worker-owned scratch directory at <worker>/t/<16-hex SHA-256 prefix of the absolute raw attempt root>. TEMP, TMP, and TMPDIR all name it. The runner records its pre-cleanup manifest and removes it after the child exits; redirection, stale reuse, or cleanup failure is an apparatus error.
apparatus_path_policy.child_path_gate: Before each child starts, the runner verifies the absolute frozen Python, runner, source, worktree, temp, focal-target, leaf-record, and JUnit paths against the Windows budget.
apparatus_path_policy.compact_paths: Fresh worktree and run directory names use compact hash/time tokens. Full merge, worker, runner, protocol, and timestamp provenance is stored in result records rather than repeated in child-facing directory names.
apparatus_path_policy.batch_publication: Site results are staged under generation run roots. The first site-execution apparatus error detected before publication stops the batch and publishes zero new top-level results; only an apparatus-clean runtime/runner postflight permits the publication phase.

environment.python_path_rule: <attempt>/src when present, otherwise <attempt>; append the fixed Click compatibility root for Click only

policy.TEMP/TMP/TMPDIR: the same per-process worker-owned isolated short temporary root
